newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds firmer, NY boosts sentimen.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds firmer, NY boosts sentimen.

text.p: Strength on London's August white sugar contract dragged further forwards higher on Wednesday as the spot month held onto earlier gains after breaking nearby $320 resistance, traders said.
Traders said the rally was sparked by mainly outright dealings, adding that the firmness on July raws was also helping sentiment in London.
Local sources have said July buy stops are placed around 11.14 cents/lb, which -- if triggered -- could spark a rally in London.
Traders said the overall volume in London, which amounted to a modest 1,474 lots by 1550 GMT, was boosted by a number of crossed and against actuals trades.
The volume was better than expected considering the absence of major players due to the annual U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners' Association Dinner in New York on Wednesday, they said.
Producer pricing was said to be keeping a lid on nearby London prices.
August dominated volume with a mixed bag of players on both sides of the market throughout the day. The position was up $2.00 at $320.90, just 10 cents off its intraday high.
October was up $1.90 at $310.50 and other months were also firmer by between 60 cents and $1.70.
Paris volume amounted to a light 352 lots, with only the two front months traded. August was up $1.80 at $320.30 and October up $1.50 at $310.00.
